clips.title: The story
paras: Darkshire Town Hall stands on the western edge of the town square as the seat of local governance in Duskwood. From inside these dimly lit halls, Mayor Lord Ello Ebonlocke and his council attempt to administer a settlement besieged by creeping darkness and undead monstrosities.

Located directly west of the main town square, the Town Hall is where Darkshire's civic leadership gathers to govern an increasingly isolated territory. Within its weathered walls sits Mayor Lord Ello Ebonlocke, struggling to preserve civil order and protect the populace while Stormwind offers little in the way of military aid. Alongside the mayor, municipal officials like Clerk Daltry work to track local records and the travelers braving Duskwood's dangerous roads, though keeping ledgers current is a grim and challenging task in such perilous times.
